risk_note: RV2 migration (data model only; settlement-plan B2-04a, BR-FUND-04 / 09, BR-CALC-23; S7, S8, S14; decisions 36, 41, 42). One new migration creates the settlement core tables settle_jobs, settle_bills, settle_batches (with the S8 paused-by-switch marker), settle_batch_items (two partial uniques), beneficiary_credits (status=open partial unique), settle_adjust_batches, settle_adjustments and recon_union: status CHECKs from contracts/enums/fund.yaml matching the B2-04d state machines (settle_jobs three states, S7), named constraints and indexes, foreign keys to order_keys without cascade, row_version on the four status tables for CAS (money round 1). Grants: couli_app SELECT / INSERT plus column-level UPDATE only where the flow writes later — settle_batch_items.amount_fen at supplementary execution (decision 41), settle_bills' six summary columns and generated_at backfilled after generation (decision 42), status / row_version / timestamps — other amounts stay non-updatable; couli_readonly SELECT. payout_batch_items is not here (S14, B2-06). Two SET LOCAL timeouts; no DO block. db/schema.sql and db.gen.ts regenerated on the test machine; tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts lists the eight new funds tables (additions only).
